source_title: Rangers fan views on 2-2 draw with Hearts - BBC
source_excerpt:
We asked for your views after Rangers netted a late equaliser to draw 2-2 with Hearts on Derek McInnes' return to Tynecastle.
Derek: Get out jail result. Could've won it at the end. Djeidi Gassama and Kim Min-su should've been hooked at half-time. Findlay Curtis did more in the last seven minutes than they did the time they were on the park. Sadly McInnes looked devoid of ideas on how to change it. As for Emmanuel Fernandez, the less said the better! Lacked a captain and leader on the park.
Iain: Yet again more points dropped away from home, a far from consistent or convincing team. Djon Sterling said prior to the game the "right Rangers" would beat any team in Scotland, the problem is the "right Rangers" don't turn up anywhere near often enough.
Sally: Rangers failed to control the midfield, allowing Hearts to break quickly. Gassama needs to be more consistent with Curtis as his replacement. Hearts were the better team on the night.
Billy: Another patchy performance, lucky to avoid defeat. Lost momentum since the Old Firm victories. Consistently inconsistent.
Stuart: Usual frailties exposed and McInnes failed to make a difficult but key decision - substituting Fernandez. If Ben Godfrey can't step in when a central defender is struggling badly then Rangers have a big problem. And it is being regularly exposed.
Steven: More dropped points and another 90 minutes that lack conviction and any real quality. I don't understand McInnes' delay in making the changes. Players on the park too long having make little to no impact. Curtis and Bojan Miovski came on too late and only Sterling will know how he missed that chance! Fernandez continues to confound. I cannot fathom how he starts. That being said, Olwethu Makhanya looks like a really good player and hopefully we can hold on to him.
